notes.title: Digitized Organism
notes.content:
Recently, there was a change in our team. Some original members who created the original name decided to leave. The rest of us will continue to stay and we just wanted to rename the new team.

Rest assured that we are still supporting this game. As of now, our future projects will shift to a new direction. Thank you for all of your supports so far. We will keep learning from the past and improving the future.

notes.title: Stuttering
notes.content:
Possible causes of the stuttering:

1. Some software may be interfering with the game
2. The system's software are not up to date
3. Video recording software is set to max quality rendering

Solutions (please only do this if you have stuttering)

1. Make sure you restart your computer after installing
2. update you drivers
3. Lower quality of your video recording software (I have this problem). Try to turn it off to see if it is the reason causing stuttering.


One member found  this solution. Please try this also:

using Nvidia control panel, force vsync and triple buffer

notes.title: Controller Guide
notes.content:
When you are using a controller, please use the right-analog stick to navigate on the food, health, map, etc bar. After you can navigate, click the right-analog to activate its function. 

Please DO NOT use the D-pad. For some reason it screws up everything.

We can only have partial controller support. Sorry for this inconvenience.
